_readme: Drive ids filled from work/drive_ids.json and the booklet part list. Every file must be shared as Anyone with the link can view. bytes and sha256 were computed from the build output; the script verifies each download against them. Any value still reading PASTE... or PARTnn_ID is a placeholder and the real run refuses to start.

migration._comment: oldLessons: the 117 live IAL Biology lessons as listed on production 2026-10-17 (order, stored subtopicName, title) and the owner's mapping to new lesson n. The first old order per n is PRIMARY (document kept and updated in place); later ones are MERGED into it (videos moved, references repointed, then deleted after backup). Old subtopic names are renamed to the new name of the lesson they map to. extraRenames: optional "old name": "new spine name" pairs for stamped names that no old lesson carries (for example "Continuous & Discontinuous Variation"); left empty for a human to decide.
